claim: For finite logits and at least one allowed movement action, a categorical STOP/movement policy exactly factors into a STOP Bernoulli and conditional movement softmax. Factorization alone is therefore not a distinct probability model; changed supervision/features/decision rules could still matter.
evidence_type: DEDUCTION and EXECUTED NUMERICAL CHECK; not benchmark evidence
